title: Hearty Japanese Tofu Ramen
description: A buttery and creamy vegan ramen dish featuring lemon zest and coconut cream, inspired by the romantic Japanese Tohoku region.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the ramen noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the mushrooms until they are tender.
Add the cubed tofu to the pan and cook until it is golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut cream and lemon zest.
Add the coconut cream mixture to the pot with the noodles and broth, and stir to combine.
Add the sauteed mushrooms and tofu to the pot, and stir to combine.
Stir in the vegan butter until it is melted and the soup is creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the ramen hot, topped with green onions and vegan cheese shreds.
